chunks: From him, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
The Misri and the Yamani will appear before the Sufyani.

key_terms.السُّفۡيَانِيُّ: Al-Sufyani, a prominent figure in Shia eschatology whose appearance is a major sign of the end times.
key_terms.مِصۡرِيّٖ: The Egyptian, a specific leader or figure emerging from Egypt during the pre-Mahdi era.
key_terms.يَمَانِيّٖ: The Yemeni, a leader emerging from Yemen who will call people to the truth before the Mahdi's appearance.

ai.seo_question: Who appears before the Sufyani in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In Shia eschatology, the emergence of the Yamani is considered a favorable sign of guidance, contrasting with the Sufyani's tyranny, as detailed in Shaykh al-Tusi's *Kitab al-Ghayba*. The 'Misri' (often identified as the killer of the Yamani) and the 'Yamani' (the caller to truth) act as pivotal figures whose actions precede the Sufyani's rise, marking the transition from the minor to the major occultation's culmination.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 444 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukair from Muhammad bin Muslim that he said: “
Misri and Yamani will appear before Sufyani.”
